claude -p --permission-mode acceptEdits --output-format text --no-session-persistence --model claude-opus-5-5 -- 'Reply with exactly <challenge>. Do not run tools, modify files or contact the physical robot.

ENGINEERING ONLY: offline/source/replay/tests/review. No Docker/MuJoCo/MC or live ROS graph. Never label offline tests SIM_VERIFIED. Request L3_QUALIFICATION for runtime evidence; missing hardware facts -> NEEDS_HARDWARE; preserve evidence, then work on an independent issue. Source fixes require diagnosis={hypotheses,reproduction,causal_evidence,original_fail_retest,regression} and root_causes with VERIFIED status and evidence; no fix before causal reproduction. Rules: simulation only; never contact the physical X2 (no ssh/deploy/ros2 pub); do not weaken safety limits or goal tolerances; work only in your own git worktree; commit nothing to shared branches; on usage limit stop and exit (state is recovered from SQLite and Git).'
